## What's new: skills that load when you need them, and a plugin that tells you it's out of date

- **Overriding a stock asset now loads the right skill.** "I edited a stock anim/model/script but the game still uses the original" used to load nothing. It now loads `t7kb:compiling`, which explains the fix (comment the asset's line out of `zone_source/all/assetlist/*.csv` at the BO3 root) and two traps that make it silently fail: editing the map's own `<map>.csv` (the linker rewrites it on every link), and commenting with `#` instead of `//`.
- **Zombie AI and pasted GSC load their skills too.** Zombies stuck in their idle "dance" or a dog round that never ends now load `t7kb:zombies-ai` reliably, and pasting a GSC snippet without naming the game loads `t7kb:scripting` more often.
- **Know when your skills are stale.** A plugin from a third-party marketplace doesn't update itself, so an old install can keep old skills for months. `t7kb update-check` (also run by `/t7kb:setup`) now lists every outdated install of the plugin, per scope, with the exact commands to update each one.
- **Search ranking, corrected.** 2.3.0 also ranked reliable sources (API pages, Treyarch's scripts) higher. On a second set of questions judged blind, that pushed down community threads where they are the best answer (easter-egg songs, water, localization), so 2.3.1 removes it and keeps only the title match boost. The "86%, up from 71%" in 2.3.0's notes was measured on the questions the ranking was tuned on; on the blind set, a key source is in the top 5 for 83% of questions, as before 2.3.0.
